input.note:
## Root Cause

The `catalog-reindex` CronJob's Wednesday run (Job `catalog-reindex-29654040`, pod `catalog-reindex-29654040-v8m2q`) is still marked **Active** after 2+ days because its `cloud-sql-proxy` sidecar container is still running, even though the main `reindex` container finished successfully at 02:41:17Z on 2026-05-20 (exit code 0).

Because `cloud-sql-proxy` is defined as a regular container (not a Kubernetes-native sidecar init container), Kubernetes does not automatically terminate it when the main container exits. The pod therefore never reaches a terminal state, and the Job stays Active.

The CronJob is configured with `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, which skips any new scheduled run while a previous Job is still active [cite: concepts/workloads/controllers/cron-jobs#concurrency-policy-0]. This is why the Thursday (2026-05-21) and Friday (2026-05-22) 02:00 runs were both skipped — the Wednesday job was still running [cite: concepts/workloads/controllers/cron-jobs#job-creation-1].

## Evidence

- Pod `catalog-reindex-29654040-v8m2q` container states:
  - `reindex`: `Terminated (Completed)`, exit code 0, finished `2026-05-20T02:41:17Z`
  - `cloud-sql-proxy`: `Running since 2026-05-20T02:00:05Z` (2+ days ago)
- Job status: `Active: 1 running, 0 succeeded, 0 failed (age 2d6h)`
- CronJob `lastScheduleTime`: `2026-05-20T02:00:00Z` — no new runs have been scheduled since Wednesday.

## Fix

### Immediate (unblock tonight's run)
Delete the stuck Job so the CronJob is free to create a new one at 02:00 tonight:
```
kubectl delete job catalog-reindex-29654040 -n search
```
This will also terminate the orphaned `cloud-sql-proxy` pod.

### Long-term (prevent recurrence)
Migrate `cloud-sql-proxy` from a regular container to a **Kubernetes-native sidecar container** by moving it into `spec.initContainers` with `restartPolicy: Always`. With this approach, Kubernetes automatically terminates the sidecar after the main container exits, allowing the Job to complete cleanly [cite: concepts/workloads/pods/sidecar-containers#jobs-with-sidecar-containers-0]. Example snippet:

```yaml
initContainers:
  - name: cloud-sql-proxy
    image: gcr.io/cloud-sql-connectors/cloud-sql-proxy:2.11.4
    restartPolicy: Always   # ← marks this as a native sidecar
    args:
      - "--port=5432"
      - "acme-prod:us-central1:catalog-db"
containers:
  - name: reindex
    image: registry.internal/search/catalog-reindex:4.2.0
```
